subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: After the lifecycle cleanup finding is fixed, should this PR require after-fix live Discord voice proof or may maintainers explicitly accept the dependency-backed Testbox proof as sufficient?
rationale: The PR targets a real Discord runtime path, but the discussion says no configured live multi-account Discord voice setup is currently available, so only a maintainer can decide whether to override the normal real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Require live proof after cleanup
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording from a real Discord setup showing two account-scoped voice joins or the already-ready autoJoin path before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can accept the dependency contract plus focused Testbox coverage if a live multi-account Discord setup is not reasonably available.

options.title: Pause until environment exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged until someone with a suitable Discord voice environment can produce the missing proof.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after cleanup
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording from a real Discord setup showing two account-scoped voice joins or the already-ready autoJoin path before merge.
